Record an original, audience-specific visual direction and a staged, reversible public-site refresh.

## Acceptance criteria

- Identify the public routes and phased work orders, design constraints, reference sources, and rollback order.
- Keep this scope documentation-only; do not start implementation or claim design approval beyond the owner's request.
- Report any conflict with existing settled decisions for owner resolution.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks

## Check-in plan
Owner tooling prepares `.vendor-wt/wo-194` on `vendor/wo-194`. Report completion and any decision conflicts in the worktree status.
